description: This file contains a PHP trait 'PayloadParserTrait' used for parsing JSON and XML payloads within the AWS SDK for PHP. It provides methods to parse JSON strings into arrays and XML strings into SimpleXMLElement objects, with error handling and exception throwing.

methods.name: parseJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into an associative array, throws ParserException if JSON is invalid.

methods.name: parseXml
methods.description: Parses an XML string into a SimpleXMLElement object, with error handling and exception throwing.
